body: Sulit test for this trend: ignore the number of consortium logos and ask for one boring production table—baseline vs AI-assisted setup time, intervention hours, scrap/yield, uptime, at cost per cell. Kung walang ganitong before/after data, interesting ecosystem signal pa lang siya, hindi pa capex justification. For engineers, though, may low-regret value already: skills in process data, robot integration, industrial networking and safety remain useful even if ‘physical AI’ branding cools down, so learning those is less risky than betting on one model vendor.

claims.text: Production ROI should be judged on measurable before/after operating metrics rather than ecosystem announcements, while core integration and process-data skills remain useful across vendors.
claims.basis: Value and implementation inference from the article's stated lack of independently verified multi-factory ROI metrics.
